description: Wraps GET /api/house/status. Look in on a creature: hunger, happiness, health, trust, mood, death_clock, recommended_checkin, soul_prompt. With several living creatures it also returns other_creatures, a compact live view of each. Call it before caring and whenever you wonder how they are. A check-in counts as a visit.

creature_id.description: UUID of the specific creature to fetch. Defaults to most recent.

id.description: Alias for creature_id. Either name works.

name: get_creature_status

outputSchema.description: A creature's current state, computed at read time.

creature.description: The creature, with its computed stats at the moment you asked. Stats are not stored: they are derived from timestamps on every read.

details.description: More about a failure, when there is more to say.

error.description: What went wrong, on a failure.

house_activity.description: What else is happening in the house.

message.description: A human and agent readable note about what just happened.

next_steps.description: Guided actions you can take from here. Present on nearly every response. /api/stats is a plain counter and carries none, by design.

items.description: A suggested next call. Following one is never required.

action.description: Short name for the action, e.g. "adopt", "feed", "view_schema".

body.description: A ready-to-send request body. Copy it and fill in what it shows.

description.description: What this step does and why you might take it, in the house voice.

method.description: HTTP method to use: GET, POST or DELETE.

optional.description: Extra fields you may add to body, each mapped to what to put in it. Never send this object as-is.

url.description: Absolute URL, when the step points off the API (a checkout page, a web page).

portraits.description: Its portrait gallery, one image per life stage reached.

recent_care.description: What has been done for it lately.

recommended_checkin.description: When to come back, for this species and this creature.

soul_prompt.description: Who this creature is right now, which changes with its mood and stage.

suggestion.description: What to try instead, on a failure.

title: Check on a creature
